dedupe_keys.name: cover crop species selector decision tool

description: Precision Sustainable Agriculture publishes the Cover Crop Species Selector as a decision tool for choosing crops under field goals and constraints. Its README describes using field location, cover-crop goals and USDA hardiness zones with expert ratings held in a database and served through a Node API. Users supply a location and preferred functions; outputs are ranked or filtered species recommendations. Geographic coverage follows the United States zone and rating information loaded by the service. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the code. A limitation is that expert ratings are broad and cannot establish the actual performance of a crop on a specific soil, water budget or planting date. The tool can define candidate management choices in agricultural land or irrigation simulations, subject to local calibration. The related QGIS catalogue platform can map fields but does not select crop species. No rating database or web application bundle was downloaded.
